stories.title: S&P/TSX composite down more than 350 points as tech and base metal stocks sink
stories.summary: TORONTO — Canada's main stock index was down more than 350 points in late-morning trading, weighed down by losses in the technology and base metal sectors, while U.S. stocks markets were mixed. The S&P/TSX composite index was down 374.

stories.title: Ontario, Ottawa committing $250 million to help fund new port in Sault Ste. Marie
stories.summary: SAULT STE. MARIE — Ontario and the federal government say they're committing $250 million to help build a new port in Sault Ste. Marie on the north shore of the Saint Marys River.

stories.title: Recent flooding damages dikes in B.C.'s Pemberton Valley: dyking district
stories.summary: PEMBERTON, BRITISH COLUMBIA — The Pemberton Valley Dyking District says repair costs to its dikes after this month's torrential rain and flooding will be "significant." The district manages 44 kilometres of dikes around the community in B.C.
